title: Applications
subtitle: Add tools that fit the way you work.

unavailable: This plugin is no longer available

preview.title: Plugin development preview
preview.waiting: Waiting for the agent's first successful build. Uploaded revisions appear here automatically.
preview.noPage: This build has no application page. The agent can verify its backend or declared capabilities through the development SDK.
preview.installed: The final build is installed. Development preview has ended.
preview.revisionChanged: The preview revision changed. Inspect the current build before continuing.
preview.statusFailed: Could not read development status. Check the development service.
preview.bundleFailed: Could not load this build. The last successful preview is kept.
preview.commandFailed: The preview action failed. Inspect the current page and try again.
preview.observeFailed: Could not return the preview observation to the agent.
preview.logFailed: Could not save a preview diagnostic.
preview.selectInstance: Choose a development instance to reopen its preview.
preview.listFailed: Could not load development instances. Refresh to try again.

errors.developmentChatUnavailable: No current chat draft is available. Describe what you want to build in a normal chat.
errors.catalog: Could not load the plugin list: {{reason}}
errors.packageTooLarge: The plugin ZIP must not exceed 64 MiB. Choose a smaller package.
errors.packageRead: Could not read the plugin package. Select the ZIP file again.
errors.packageUnavailable: The plugin package could not be read. Select the file again.
errors.packageAborted: Reading the plugin package was canceled. Select the file again.
errors.wrongCategory: This package has no capabilities for {{category}}. Import it from the relevant section instead.

capability.background: Includes background code that can keep running after you close the page once the plugin is enabled.

trust.reader: Readers can read the contents of files you give them and display previews. Make sure you trust the source.
trust.connector: Connectors only add a way to configure a service; they do not connect automatically. Access still requires connection settings and runtime authorization.
trust.application: Application plugins run as trusted code. They can run background programs on your computer, access files and the network, and use configured models. Once installed, they do not ask for authorization for each action. Closing the page does not stop background operations. Only install plugins from sources you trust.
trust.replacement: Replaces the plugin with the same ID (v{{previous}} → v{{next}}). The old version is kept if the update fails.
trust.install: The entire package will be installed with all the capabilities listed above. Existing connections, service settings, and files will be kept.
trust.disable: Disables the entire plugin package and all its capabilities. You can enable it again later.
trust.rollback: Restores the entire plugin package to the one saved previous version. You cannot switch back to the current version afterward.
trust.uninstall: Uninstalls the entire plugin package and removes all its capabilities. You can import it again if needed.
trust.preserve: Existing connections, service settings, and files will be kept. Built-in capabilities are not affected.
